prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production bitmap background for a virtual city car game, ONE full-bleed 16:9 landscape scene, preferably2048x1152. This is a fictional evolved Busan game world, not documentary accuracy.
DRIVER CAMERA: stopped vehicle FIRST-PERSON, 1.3m eye above actual DRIVABLE ROAD, level rectilinear28mm lens. Central road vanishing point, eye-level horizon approximately midheight (43-55% fromtop). Drivable ROAD must reach the ENTIRE BOTTOM EDGE and fill lower foreground. Camera within the driving lane. Roadside buildings and landmark recede in SAME unified perspective. NOT aerial,isometric,elevated,sidewalk,boardwalk,promenade,postcard view. Do not show any dashboard,car hood,steering wheel,device,windshield frame or UI.
PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM: neutral4pm daylight under thin high cloud, real camera exposure, subdued plausible contrast, varied independently designed facades. Actual stone/wood/brick/concrete surface grain, joints, drainage and believable weathering; physically supported roofs, continuous bridge load paths, coherent shadows. Do not add waxy CGI gloss, blurred texture soup, repetitive cloned towers, neon fantasy, floating buildings, oversaturated teal-orange grading or excessive bloom. Subtle imperfections and human-scale details. Only a few distant natural people if any, no malformed foreground figures.
LANDMARK: physically belongs to street in middle distance, roads connect to its actual approach/forecourt; readable but not pasted or enlarged separate photograph. Distinct location identity. Leave quiet upper sky for native HUD but draw NO text,logos,sign writing,watermarks,HUD or panels. Output only this one scene, no collage.
EXACT LEVEL 9: Ecological waterfront city. Road with actual drivable asphalt centre, permeable edges, lush rain gardens and restored shoreline/water-sensitive canal, diverse green terraced eco-buildings, sustainable timber/concrete. No forest blocking road.
LOCATION CENTUM / BUSAN CINEMA CENTER: Ecological Cinema Center with recognisable asymmetric Big Roof and curved double-cone forms, planted outdoor auditorium edges, living terraces and water-sensitive canal/landscape beside road. Contemporary-plus, not advanced flying city.
Naturally photographed virtual reconstruction; all geometry and materials agree with THIS level.
